perOption.reason: 'know [where we are headed] and [what we want to do]' coordinates two wh-clauses as objects of 'know'. 'what' is a fused relative filling the object gap of transitive 'do' ('we want to do __'); a nominal filler is required, so 'what' is exactly right ('that' would leave 'do' without an object). Grammatical.

perOption.reason: 'we have [to adjust to a postponement] or [create ...]' — obligation 'have to' licenses coordinated infinitival complements with the second 'to' elided ('have to adjust or (to) create'). Standard parallel structure; the to-infinitive after 'have' (obligation) is required. Grammatical.

perOption.label: (D)

A purpose-infinitive adverbial reading ('in order to spend') fails semantically because spending the hours is the result, not the purpose, of ending up. No alternative parse makes 'end up to spend' grammatical. Should be 'end up spending'.
